materiality: HiggsAudio v2 voice-clone requests can produce identical scheduler-visible placeholder token ids for different reference audios with the same encoded frame count, while the predecessor adapter discarded the content-aware reference-audio cache key.

Without a content-derived cache salt, prefix caching can therefore reuse KV state from a different speaker/reference recording; the successor preserves the resolved audio cache key and incorporates it into the request cache salt while leaving text-only prompts unchanged.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact vLLM-Omni/vLLM source and package or image identities plus the speech adapter configuration. Synthetic cache-key correctness may run without model weights; any real HiggsAudio checkpoint execution additionally requires exact model revision/file identity and completed license review because the observed Hugging Face model license is `other`.

Execute an immediate predecessor or equivalent known-bad control with two byte-distinct reference audios that produce the same placeholder token ids and shape; prove the predecessor produces the same prefix-cache identity while the candidate produces distinct salts without exposing raw reference audio in logs or receipts.

Exercise identical audio, different audio with equal duration/frame count, transcript changes, text-only requests, concurrent speakers, cancellation, restart and cache warm/cold transitions; verify identical admitted conditioning reuses cache and distinct conditioning never reuses another request's KV state.

Record only hashes/derived non-secret identities for synthetic audio fixtures, fail closed on missing or malformed reference-audio identity, preserve prefix-cache-disable as rollback, and do not publish, mirror or production-route the upstream voice model from this source qualification.

materiality: On ROCm DeepSeek-V4 speculative serving, draft workers have compression ratio zero and no compressed-KV/indexer pool, but predecessor HIP radix metadata builders still requested compressed metadata unconditionally, causing startup assertion failure; the unified-KV path could then dereference absent compressed page data.

The successor derives the compression requirement from draft-worker identity, preserves target-worker behavior, uses empty compressed metadata for draft workers while retaining SWA verify-store streams, and therefore changes a startup/memory-safety boundary rather than a cosmetic performance path.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact SGLang source/build, ROCm/HIP/Torch/AITER or related backend identities, exact DeepSeek-V4 checkpoint/config/tokenizer identity, speculative algorithm, TP/DP topology, unified-KV backend setting and accelerator model. CUDA-only evidence cannot qualify this ROCm lane.

Preserve an immediate predecessor known-bad startup control showing the missing draft indexer/compressed metadata failure and, where applicable, the follow-on absent-page dereference; separately preserve any prerequisite successor such as the already-merged pool-sizing/device-tree fixes rather than attributing their effects to this commit.

Exercise DSpark and every actually supported EAGLE/MTP draft path, unified_kv_triton on/off, CUDA-graph capture/replay, target versus draft workers, empty compressed tails, SWA verify-store writes, cancellation and restart; require no OOB, NaN, stale cache state or accidental compressed-pool allocation on draft workers.

Compare deterministic outputs/accepted-token behavior against non-speculative or independently qualified reference serving on affected ROCm hardware before performance claims; if MI3xx-class hardware or exact model access is unavailable, emit UNAVAILABLE/HOLD and preserve non-speculative serving as rollback.
